payload.claim: The comment justifies `_CHUNK_BYTES` as needing to be 'a multiple of 4 so no piece ever splits base64 mid-symbol,' but the implementation never decodes a piece on its own — every piece is appended verbatim to the scratch file and the whole concatenation is decoded once at line 514. Since decoding happens only after full reassembly, piece boundaries never need base64-alignment; the stated reason for the constant is not actually load-bearing, though the constant itself (100,000, divisible by 4 anyway) is fine and nothing behaves incorrectly.
